title: A physics-constrained emulator for time-discretised landslide runout modelling
abstract: arXiv:2611.21015v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Numerical simulations of landslides are commonly used to forecast impact areas. Full physics-based models provide accurate predictions, but their computational expense can preclude their use for large parameter sweeps. To achieve efficient modelling for such cases, we developed a physics-constrained neural network to emulate full landslide runout in a time-discretised manner. This emulator is trained on over 200,000 samples, each consisting of a pair of landslide thicknesses and velocities on a given DEM with a fixed time interval. To constrain the model's physical consistency, we define physics-based loss functions based on mass conservation and the system's kinetic energy loss. The model demonstrates high fidelity across the test dataset, achieving root mean square errors of approximately 0.06 m for thickness and 0.11 m/s for velocity in single-step predictions. In autoregressive rollout, these errors evolved modestly to about 0.21 m a

translated_title: 一种面向时间离散化滑坡运动建模的物理约束模拟器
translated_abstract: 滑坡数值模拟通常被用于预测滑坡的影响区域。基于完整物理过程的模型能够提供准确的预测，但其高昂的计算成本使其难以用于大规模参数扫描。为了在这类场景下实现高效建模，我们开发了一种物理约束神经网络，以时间离散化的方式模拟完整的滑坡运动过程。该模拟器基于超过20万个样本进行训练，每个样本由给定数字高程模型（DEM）上固定时间间隔的一对滑坡厚度和速度场组成。为约束模型的物理一致性，我们基于质量守恒和系统动能损失定义了物理损失函数。该模型在整个测试数据集上表现出高保真度，单步预测中厚度和速度的均方根误差分别约为0.06米和0.11米/秒。在自回归滚动预测中，这些误差仅温和增长至约0.21米……
tldr: 该研究提出一种以质量守恒和动能损失作为物理约束的神经网络模拟器，能够以时间离散化、自回归的方式高保真且高效地模拟滑坡运动全过程，从而克服了全物理模型计算成本过高、难以支撑大规模参数扫描的问题。
en_tdlr: A physics-constrained neural network emulator, trained with mass-conservation and kinetic-energy-loss loss functions, efficiently and accurately emulates time-discretised landslide runout in an autoregressive manner, overcoming the prohibitive computational cost of full physics-based models for large parameter sweeps.
